# CharCoat

> > CharCoat provides passive fire protection and firestopping solutions through intumescent coatings, sealants, and panels for cables, structural steel, and industrial equipment.

CharCoat specializes in passive fire protection technologies including intumescent coatings, firestop systems, and thermal insulation products for critical infrastructure, oil & gas, and industrial applications. The company serves global markets with solutions validated for hydrocarbon fires, jet fires, and high-temperature environments.

## Key Topics

- Intumescent coatings
- Passive fire protection
- Cable fire protection
- Structural steel protection
- Jet fire protection
- Firestop penetration seals
- Hydrocarbon fire resistance
- Thermal insulation
- Industrial safety
- Fire-rated systems
- CharCoat CC
- CharCoat 1709
- CharCoat SC
- CharCoat JF
- Oil & Gas applications

## Fire Protection Coatings

- [CharCoat CC | Passive Fire Protection Cable Coating](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-cc): Intumescent cable coating for hydrocarbon and jet fire protection
- [CharCoat 1709 | High Performance Passive Fire Protection Coating](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-1709): Epoxy intumescent coating for structural steel protection in hydrocarbon environments
- [CharCoat SC | Structural Steel Fire Protection Coating](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-sc): Water-based intumescent coating for structural steel fire protection
- [CharCoat JF | Jet Fire Protection Coating for Oil & Gas](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-jf): Epoxy intumescent coating specifically designed for jet fire protection in oil and gas facilities
- [CharCoat CTI | Ceramic Thermal Insulation](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-cti): Ceramic thermal insulation coating with corrosion protection for high-temperature applications
- [CharCoat IC | Fire Protective Insulator Coating](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-ic): RTV silicone coating for high-voltage insulator protection and hydrophobic performance

## Firestop Systems & Sealants

- [CharCoat FM | Fire Rated Mortar for Penetrations](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-fm): Gypsum-perlite firestop mortar for cable and pipe penetration sealing
- [CharCoat IS | Intumescent Fire Sealant](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-is): Water-based intumescent sealant for fire-rated penetrations and joints
- [CharCoat FP | Fire Rated Panels](https://www.charcoat.com/product/charcoat-fp): Fire-rated panels with stone wool core for penetration firestopping systems
- [Firestop Penetration Seal Systems](https://www.charcoat.com/solutions/firestop-penetration-seals): Complete firestop solutions for cable and pipe penetrations using CharCoat products

## Fire Protection Solutions

- [Cable Fire Protection Systems](https://www.charcoat.com/solutions/cable-fire-protection): Passive fire protection solutions for cables featuring CharCoat CC coating technology
- [Structural Steel Fire Protection Systems](https://www.charcoat.com/solutions/structural-steel-fire-protection): Comprehensive structural steel fire protection featuring CharCoat SC intumescent coating
- [Hydrocarbon Fire Protection for Structural Steel](https://www.charcoat.com/solutions/hydrocarbon-structural-steel-fire-protection): Hydrocarbon fire protection solution for structural steel using CharCoat 1709
- [Jet Fire Protection Solutions for Oil & Gas](https://www.charcoat.com/solutions/jet-fire-protection): Specialized jet fire protection for oil and gas facilities using CharCoat JF
- [Industrial Thermal Insulation Solutions](https://www.charcoat.com/solutions/thermal-insulation): High-temperature thermal insulation solutions featuring CharCoat CTI ceramic coating
- [Insulator Protection Solutions](https://www.charcoat.com/solutions/insulator-protection): Fire and thermal insulation safety solutions with CharCoat IC hydrophobic coating

## Industry Applications

- [Oil & Gas Fire Protection Solutions](https://www.charcoat.com/industry/oil-gas): Fire protection solutions tailored for oil and gas industry applications
- [Infrastructure & Utilities](https://www.charcoat.com/industry/infrastructure-utilities): Fire protection for power systems, substations, and critical infrastructure
- [Industrial Plants](https://www.charcoat.com/industry/industrial-plants): Fire and thermal protection solutions for industrial plant operations
